review_title: Rinse before outdoor use to prevent color bleeding!
review_text: I bought these to add some festive beauty around the door outside my condo complex. The neighbors love it as much as I do. Exactly what I wanted in a garland, definitely looks best with two strands together side by side if you want a more thick/full look, but they seemed pretty good as a single strand as well, depending on what you are looking for. The colors are great and I love that there are such a variety so they look more realistic. I shook them all around in multiple ways and I did not have any leaves ever fall off so the quality seems great. The only reason I deducted one star is because, as other reviewers have mentioned, I had to do the extra steps of taking each strand and running it under cold water in my tub to remove excess color so that it would not bleed when it rains outside. I guess that only matters if you plan to use this outside. I took each strand and ran it under the cold tap in the tub and agitated it around a bit and then use my handheld showerhead to ensure there was no more dye. There was not as much color coming off as I expected based on the reviews but I assume it is because other people filled the tub with water and then soaked all of them together, which I did not do. After a quick rinse, I put them in a large garment bag and put them in the dryer on the gentle/low heat cycle for about 20 minutes.

review_title: Soft, cute, well made — I’d buy more
review_text: These are even cuter in person. They arrived clean and protected in a resealable zip-top bag, which I really liked. You don’t have to cut the packaging open, so I’m keeping the bags to store the covers in after Halloween.Right out of the package they were extremely soft. There was a very subtle new-fabric smell, but nothing strong or unpleasant. The raised ghosts are actually fluffy and dimensional, rather than just being a printed design, and the black embroidered faces give them a really cute 3D look. The back has a smooth, almost suede-like feel.The covers feel sturdy and the stitching looks good. The zipper is small and discreet, so you really don’t notice it when it’s closed. Looking at the inside, I did notice a few loose ends from the black embroidery, but they don’t affect the appearance from the outside.One thing I wish they had included is a care-instruction tag. There isn’t one sewn into the covers, so you’ll need to refer back to the listing, which says to machine wash cold on gentle and tumble dry low.I also agree with the listing’s “spooky neutral” description. They’re Halloween-themed without being bright or overly cartoonish, so they’re easy to work into regular home decor. The listing mentions using them on a porch, but personally I wouldn’t. The white plush material and embroidery feel much better suited to indoor use, especially if you want to keep them looking nice.I bought the 18x18 set of two, and I would absolutely buy more for my other throw pillows. They are palm size, well stuffed…not flat or stitched lopsided. The lil orange plush tray is off though. My one complaint is that the chain part of it, is weak. So have to be careful of you may end up loosing you boo buddy if it snags. I did a first purchase then my second purchase it had went up about a buck and some change. They really are stinkin cute.
